source.method: SHA-256 exact deduplication followed by conservative title/path version-family collapse; all classifications and scores are heuristic.

statuses.established idea: Uses practices with an existing real-world evidence base; this archive instance is still not independently validated.
statuses.integration: Combines known ideas or components in a distinctive architecture; integration value is plausible, not proven.
statuses.hypothesis: Makes a testable proposition that requires evidence, falsification criteria, and independent review.
statuses.experimental prototype: An interactive or technical demonstration suitable for controlled evaluation, not operational reliance.
statuses.field-test candidate: Structured enough for an ethics-reviewed, bounded, reversible pilot with monitoring and stop conditions.
statuses.speculative concept: Exploratory future-facing idea; mechanism, feasibility, or impact is substantially unverified.

layers.module: A reusable functional component with a recognizable input/output role.
layers.pattern: A repeatable way to combine modules or organize work.
layers.system: A larger architecture coordinating multiple modules and stakeholders.
layers.deployment: A place- or problem-specific application candidate.
layers.dataset: Structured records, registries, manifests, or measurements.
layers.research: Methods, papers, evidence reviews, or testable research directions.
layers.safety: Safeguards, risk controls, incident learning, or zero-harm constraints.
layers.innovation: Novel or experimental mechanisms and invention hypotheses.

scores.compatibility: Interface-readiness estimate from local operation, structured data, import/export, modular language, accessibility, and external dependencies.
scores.evidence: Documentation signal from sources, references, methodology, uncertainty, corroboration, and validation language—not a quality appraisal of cited evidence.
scores.safety: Presence of safeguards, consent, privacy, uncertainty, reversibility, auditability, and zero-harm language—not a safety certification.
scores.maturity: Artifact completeness signal from size, interaction, persistence, documentation, accessibility, and export/print support—not field readiness.

recipes.outcome: Separate observation from interpretation, corroborate claims, and route high-risk signals into de-escalation instead of narrative escalation.

recipes.evidenceGate: Preserve raw observations, source timestamps, dissenting interpretations, and confidence changes.

steps: Define one watershed or habitat boundary

recipes.evidenceGate: Use baseline/control comparisons and report null or adverse outcomes alongside successes.

recipes.title: Housing-to-dignity pathway
recipes.outcome: Connect immediate shelter, decentralized governance, food security, and livelihood pathways without coercive profiling.
steps: Start with unconditional safety and housing
Let affected people govern success criteria
recipes.safetyGate: No surveillance, forced treatment, punitive scoring, or loss of services for nonparticipation.
recipes.evidenceGate: Measure housing stability, wellbeing, service access, user-defined outcomes, and unintended exclusion.

recipes.title: Youth agency commons
recipes.outcome: Pair anti-manipulation safeguards with child-centered participation, local data, and auditable incident learning.
steps: Map manipulative patterns without profiling children
Escalate only through accountable human institutions
recipes.safetyGate: Child rights, data minimization, guardian/advocate review, and non-retaliation are mandatory.
recipes.evidenceGate: Distinguish observed harms from inferred intent; include age-appropriate participatory evaluation.
